ticker: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh
Israel election exit polls indicate deadlock
India seals T20 series against New Zealand
Houthis claim attack on Saudi oil facility
GST rules and registration norms updated

articles.headline: Cyclone Arnab makes severe landfall on Andhra coast
articles.brief: Very severe cyclonic storm Arnab has begun its landfall process near Narsapur and Yanam. Tens of thousands of residents have been evacuated, while flight and train services remain heavily disrupted across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

articles.headline: Israel election exit polls show tight parliamentary deadlock
articles.brief: Initial exit polls from the Israeli elections indicate a narrow edge for the opposition, leaving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his rivals short of a clear majority. Coalition arithmetic will likely determine the final outcome.

articles.headline: India secures T20 series victory over New Zealand
articles.brief: Team India clinched the T20 series in dominant fashion following a brilliant century from opening batsman Abhishek, which completely flattened the New Zealand bowling attack.

articles.headline: Houthis claim missile strike on Saudi oil refinery
articles.brief: Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for a missile attack targeting the Ras Tanura oil refinery in Saudi Arabia, prompting loud blasts to shake Riyadh and intensifying regional security concerns.

articles.headline: India court orders takedown of Adani-Modi documentary
articles.brief: An Indian court has issued an official order demanding the removal of a controversial documentary focusing on billionaire Gautam Adani and Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

articles.headline: Opposition plans public impeachment event against CEC
articles.brief: Following venue snubs in Delhi, opposition parties have announced plans to hold a mock public impeachment event against Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar at the residence of Mallikarjun Kharge.

articles.headline: Supreme Court warns pharma industry over free market
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India stated that authorities cannot allow the pharmaceutical industry to run amok under the guise of a free market, emphasizing the need for strict consumer protection and pricing regulations.

articles.headline: Regional rural banks to establish cybersecurity centres
articles.brief: Regional rural banks across India are setting up dedicated cybersecurity centres to enhance digital infrastructure, develop advanced threat intelligence, and protect rural financial services from emerging cyber risks.

articles.headline: Centre eases GST registration norms for MSME sector
articles.brief: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs has simplified GST registration norms for MSMEs by dropping mandatory Udyam proof requirements and establishing a strict seven-day approval timeline.

articles.headline: India Inc seeks AI talent to transform manufacturing
articles.brief: Corporate leaders across India are actively hunting for specialized artificial intelligence talent to modernize factory floors, automate supply chains, and transform traditional manufacturing operations.

articles.headline: Tata Electronics exports near one lakh crore rupees
articles.brief: Tata Electronics' exports are projected to approach Rs 1 lakh crore in fiscal year 2026, driven heavily by Apple's accelerating manufacturing and sourcing push inside the Indian market.

articles.headline: Microsoft evaluates voluntary exits for global staff
articles.brief: Microsoft's sweeping corporate exit plan could impact thousands of employees across its extensive workforce network, prompting major workforce transitions and tech sector discussions.

articles.headline: San Diego student wins prize for wearable stethoscope
articles.brief: A high school student from San Diego has secured a prestigious national entrepreneurship prize for developing an innovative wearable stethoscope designed to dramatically improve respiratory diagnostics in rural clinics.

articles.headline: Mumbai airport hit by severe check-in network outage
articles.brief: A major technical network outage at Mumbai Airport forced airline staff to switch to manual check-in procedures, causing widespread delays across hundreds of domestic and international flights.
